description: Defect and writer-quirk fixtures (D-59). They are not G2 corpus files. Each names the tests that use it; those tests rerun the validators with the installed tools. A result is pass, fail, not-run, or unsupported, and an unsupported result names the tool version and the reason.

fixtures.exercises: Standard security revision 2 whose /P pypdf writes as the unsigned 32-bit 4294966244 for -1052 (print, annotate, and fill allowed; modify, copy, and assemble refused), with passwords user-secret and owner-secret.

validators.property: qpdf --check of the filled and signed output under the opening password
the filled field value in the signed output
the signature is valid and covers the whole file
signature byte-range integrity and cryptographic validity (no trust)
